title: Burns
summary: Cool the burn quickly and keep it clean.
doSteps: Move them away from the heat source safely.
Cool the burn under cool running water for 20 minutes.
Remove rings, watches or tight clothing near the burn, unless stuck to the skin.
Cover the burn loosely with clean cling film or a clean, non-fluffy cloth.
Keep the rest of the body warm.
dontSteps: Do not put ice, butter, toothpaste, oil or palm oil on a burn.
Do not pull off clothing that is stuck to the skin.
